szoveg_eredeti:
Gemini 4 Hydrogen brings cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.

While Carbon and Argon handle deep reasoning on your hardest problems, Hydrogen is built for rapid software engineering tasks, multimodal synthesis, and more.

It comes with four thinking levels, cleaner code edits, and updated safeguards. 

Now rolling out for:
Developers: Build with the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, and in Google Antigravity for paid Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.
Enterprises: Deploy via Gemini for business, Google Antigravity, and Gemini in Google Sheets.
Everyone: Access it in Google Search and the Gemini app model dropdown.

See the details → https://goo.gle/4f0flNm
